gen-gf-neucha-sora: Hand-inked and friendly, with a nib that leaves curves open. Sora follows with geometric precision, its rounds turning corners without any pressure swell, made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-neucha-space-grotesk: Broad-nib curves that never quite close give Neucha a tight-knit, hand-drawn warmth, while Space Grotesk stays geometric below. Its ribbon-like strokes are comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-nova-cut-fs-rowan: Nova Cut is commanding and plain, its diagonals gently pressed thinner than the verticals. Rowan's generous curves and friendly literary feel suit brief copy, so make the heading the bigger of the two.
gen-gf-nova-flat-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, its curves opening wide while thin strokes sit at half the weight of thick ones. And Nova Flat does the loud work, with rounded-wire strokes of one width, leaving Rowan to carry a handful of lines.
gen-gf-nova-oval-fs-rowan: Rowan reads like a friendly novel, with generous curve openings and thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Nova Oval shouts; Rowan murmurs back.
gen-gf-nova-slim-fs-rowan: Slim and daring, Nova Slim keeps its stroke variation understated while still commanding attention. Rowan is literary and friendly, so it settles into short stretches of reading easily.
gen-gf-nova-square-fs-rowan: Nova Square has no tapering where strokes meet or end. Rowan adds gentle swelling along its curves, so the blunt heading and the softer body feel distinct on a page.
gen-gf-odibee-sans-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, with mild contrast that never turns stark. Odibee Sans holds each stroke to one thickness, and Rowan feels comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-offside-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One slows the reading pace to a leisurely walk, with curvy, unclamped letters and joins as thick as its stems. And Offside, widely tracked with curves that refuse to close, would feel lost if shrunk small.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hepta-slab: Stretched out and quietly commanding, with curves that refuse to close. Hepta Slab brings bookish dignity, its stroke weight unvarying and its counters breathing into the white space.
